content: Sulum atrainjro qaji iŋgi uyqajqa kumbra

O ijo was kalil, e sulum atrainjro qaji iŋgi uyqajqa kumbra qa niŋgi merŋgwai. Bole, iga kalil powo ti unum. Ariya iga olo diqoqnsim gago segi ñam soqtoqnqom di uge. Iga qalaqalaiyo kumbra dauryosim gago Kristen was naŋgi siŋgilatnjroqnqom di kere.
Tamo bei a marqas, “E powo ti unum.” A degsi marqo deqa iga qalieonum, aqa powo kereosaiunu.
Ariya tamo bei a Qotei qalaqalaiyoqnqas di Qotei a tamo deqa poiyqas.
Deqa e sulum atrainjro qaji iŋgi uyqajqa kumbra qa niŋgi endegsi merŋgwai. Mandamq endi sulum naŋgi unub di naŋgi gisaŋ qotei laŋa sigiteqnub. Iga qalie, Qotei bole a segi qujai unu. Qotei bei sosai.
Tamo qudei naŋgi mareqnub, “Qotei gargekoba unub. Tamo kokba dego gargekoba unub.” Tamo qudei naŋgi degsib mareqnub di uŋgum. Laŋq di, mandamq di qotei deqaji naŋgi unub di laŋa.

Iga qalieonum, Qotei qujai unu. A gago Abu. A iŋgi iŋgi kalil qa utru. Iga aqa segi tamo uŋgasari tiŋtiŋ unum. Tamo Koba qujai dego unu. Di Yesus Kristus. A iŋgi iŋgi kalil ateleŋej. Iga kalil aqaq dena ŋambile em.

Ariya Kristen qudei naŋgi anjam deqa geregere poinjrosai unu. Naŋgi nami iŋgi uyo eleŋoqnsib gisaŋ qotei naŋgo sulum atrainjroqneb. Deqa bini naŋgi iŋgi di uyqa oqnsib are gulbeinjreqnaqa endegsib are qaleqnub, “Iga sulum atrainjro qaji iŋgi di uyqom di iga sulum naŋgi olo atrainjrobulqom. Dena iga une oqom.” Naŋgi degsib are qaleqnub.
Bole, gago iŋgi uyo na iga Qotei aqa areq gilqa keresai. Iga iŋgi getentqom dena iga Qotei aqa ŋamgalaq di une ti sqasai. Iga iŋgi uyqom dena iga tamo bole sqasai dego.

Niŋgi geregere are qaliy. Niŋgi iŋgi bei uyqa are soqnim uyiy. Di une sai. Ariya niŋgi iŋgi di uyibqa Kristen was qudei powo bole osai qaji naŋgi niŋgi nuŋgsib dena uloŋosib uneq aiqab di uge. Deqa uŋgum, niŋgi iŋgi di uyaib.

Niŋgi powo bole ti unub qaji niŋgi sulum naŋgo atra tal miligiq gilsib dia iŋgi uyoqnib Kristen was bei powo bole osai qaji a bosim niŋgi nuŋgsimqa a endegsi are qalqas, “Kristen was naŋgi iŋgi di uyeqnub deqa uŋgum, e dego uyqai.” Osim a uloŋosim uneq aiqas.
Nuŋgo powo dena niŋgi na was bei di powo bole osai qaji a uneq waiyonub. Niŋgi qalie, Kristus a was deqa moiyej.
Deqa niŋgi quiy. Niŋgi na Kristen was naŋgi uneq breinjrsib naŋgo areqalo Kristus qa siŋgilateb qaji di ugetetnjrqab di niŋgi Kristus dego une yonub.
Deqa e damu uyitqa dena ijo was a uneq aiqas di e olo damu uyqasai. Ijo was a uloŋosim uneq aiyaim deqa e damu uratqai.
